lines: Phase 4 is 37 minutes old and ten build agents are working on spring and summer and fall and the seven new particle kinds
The first finished first versions are in: the fall base with its surface dressing and all seven particle kinds drawing as their own shapes
The fall base agent names its own faults: iron strands too thick and glossy and wax runs too few and pumpkin skins too plain and no mirror image on the slab yet
Phase 3's whole gate ran green again on a clean clone of its closing commit: 15 of 15
phase 4: 0.59 h used of its 9.50 h box
allowance (before the review): 22.87 h used of 36.00 h allowed
